ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Keyed click
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A Pickle step that clicks a button by the translation key its label comes from, so a scenario runs in any language. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See KeyedClick/README.md at the repository root.
It is the same step as the one proposed to Pickle itself as a pull request; when that lands this mod's step can go.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
